scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,admin,plugin "npm run dev -w @nextday/api" "npm run dev -w @nextday/web" "npm run dev -w @nextday/admin" "npm run dev -w @nextday/fishpi-plugin"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @nextday/api && npm run build -w @nextday/web && npm run build -w @nextday/admin && npm run build -w @nextday/fishpi-plugin
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @nextday/shared && npm run build -w @nextday/config-schema && npm run build -w @nextday/game-rules && npm run build -w @nextday/game-client && npm run build -w @nextday/ui
scripts.test: DATABASE_URL=postgresql://nextday:nextday@localhost:5432/nextday_game npm run build:packages && DATABASE_URL=postgresql://nextday:nextday@localhost:5432/nextday_game npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:m1: DATABASE_URL=postgresql://nextday:nextday@localhost:5432/nextday_game npm run build:packages && DATABASE_URL=postgresql://nextday:nextday@localhost:5432/nextday_game npm run test:m1 -w @nextday/api
scripts.test:m2: DATABASE_URL=postgresql://nextday:nextday@localhost:5432/nextday_game npm run build:packages && DATABASE_URL=postgresql://nextday:nextday@localhost:5432/nextday_game npm run test:m2 -w @nextday/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
